verdict.rationale: Khoj documents creating multiple agents, each with its own custom knowledge, persona or system prompt, chat model and tools, for different use cases. There is no evidence of routing specific conversations or channels (e.g. WhatsApp) to a particular agent, and per-agent knowledge is described only briefly. Missing for 10: documented routing of conversations or channels to specific agents, deeper docs on per-agent isolated workspaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: Create agents with custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools to take on any role.
You can use agents to setup custom system prompts with Khoj.
Add all the agents you want to use for your different use-cases like Writer, Researcher, Therapist etc.
